review_message: No binding/lift/normal/Cdot error found. ConvertMetric/ConvertA return tangents including metric-induced A trace, and LiftPhysical adds them once to full reference jets. ActualDual constant-10 analytic reference subtraction matches public Patch and is independent of the tangent. GaugeCdot differentiates the complete coefficient-aware actual tangent field spatially before applying physical Constraints. OutputNormals is valid at this stationary reference with zero source-subtracted geometric RHS and should not be generalized unchanged to a moving background.
